<br />

Use the **Changes** panel to track code changes made within DevTools.

## Overview

With the **Changes** panel, track the changes you make to:

- HTML in [**Sources**](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/javascript/sources#edit) with enabled [Local overrides](https://developer.chrome.com/blog/new-in-devtools-65#overrides)
- CSS in [**Elements** \> **Styles**](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/css#declarations) or [**Sources**](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/javascript/sources#edit)
- JavaScript in [**Sources**](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/javascript/sources#edit)

The **Changes** panel shows only the changes you make within DevTools. If you reload either DevTools or your page, the changes disappear.

To make DevTools persist changes across page loads, follow the steps in [Local overrides](https://developer.chrome.com/blog/new-in-devtools-65#overrides).

To make DevTools write changes to your local sources, follow the steps in [Edit and save files with Workspaces](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/workspaces).

## Open the Changes panel

To open the **Changes** panel:

1. [Open DevTools](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/open).

2. Press <kbd>Command</kbd>+<kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>P</kbd> (Mac) or <kbd>Control</kbd>+<kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>P</kbd> (Windows, Linux, ChromeOS) to open the **Command Menu**.

3. Start typing `changes`, select **Show Changes** , and press <kbd>Enter</kbd>.

   ![Run the Show Changes command](https://developer.chrome.com/static/docs/devtools/changes/image/run-show-changes-command-23263ba7e2577.png)

Alternatively, in the upper right corner, click ![](https://developer.chrome.com/static/docs/devtools/changes/image/N7wEDmtW9lnrSxPRupMa.svg) **Customize and control DevTools** \> **More tools** \> **Changes**.

![Changes option focused in More tools dropdown](https://developer.chrome.com/static/docs/devtools/changes/image/more-tools-changes-f8b7202b524b.png)

By default, DevTools displays the **Changes** panel at the bottom of your DevTools window, in the **Drawer**.

## View and understand your changes

To view your changes:

1. [Open DevTools](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/open).
2. Make changes to your sources:

   - HTML: First, enable [Local overrides](https://developer.chrome.com/blog/new-in-devtools-65#overrides), then make changes in **Sources**
   - CSS in [**Elements** \> **Styles**](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/css#declarations) or [**Sources**](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/javascript/sources#edit)
   - JavaScript in [**Sources**](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/javascript/sources#edit)
3. [Open the **Changes** panel](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/changes#open-changes) and select a file in the right-hand side of the panel.

4. Observe a `diff` output that highlights the following:

![Highlighted diff in the Changes panel](https://developer.chrome.com/static/docs/devtools/changes/image/highlighted-diff-the-cha-5ac66c9170d43.png)

The **Changes** panel pretty-prints the `diff` output automatically, so you don't have to scroll horizontally to see the changes in a single line.

## Copy CSS changes

If you made changes to CSS in [**Elements** \> **Styles**](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/css#declarations), you can copy all of them with a single button:

1. [Open the **Changes** panel](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/changes#open-changes) and, in the right-hand side of the panel, select the CSS file you made changes to.

   ![Copy.](https://developer.chrome.com/static/docs/devtools/changes/image/copy-e107336946db8.png)
2. Click the ![Copy.](https://developer.chrome.com/static/docs/devtools/changes/image/copy-ec072678afe73.svg) **Copy** button at the bottom of the **Changes panel**.

## Revert all changes made to a file

To revert changes made to a file:

1. On left-hand side of the **Changes** panel, select a file with changes to revert.
2. On the action bar at the bottom, click ![Undo](https://developer.chrome.com/static/docs/devtools/changes/image/undo-20a57d3c05e16.svg) **Revert all changes to current file**.

![Revert button](https://developer.chrome.com/static/docs/devtools/changes/image/revert-button-becf5cafcf8bf.png)
